Jump from the back inside edge, named for a ten-time world champion Swede
Harald, the Norwegian king cut down at Stamford Bridge on 25 September
One-foot turn, forward to backward, cutting a numeral in the ice
Big or little, it is what you dip in to judge the temperature
Perish for want of air beneath the surface, as weak swimmers may
